hazards.title: Cleaners
hazards.situation: Your cousin set bleach and a glass cleaner with ammonia next to an empty bucket. 'Let’s mix them to make super cleaner!'
options: Mix a little; tell Dad.
Say no. Keep both closed and apart.
Ask Dad later. Mix outdoors.
outcomes: A gas forms that hurts your eyes, nose and lungs. People cough and struggle to breathe.
No gas forms. The cleaners get used one at a time, as the label says.
The gas still forms, and you still breathe it.
hazards.habit: Never mix cleaners. One at a time.
hazards.fix: Drag the bucket away from the bottles, then tap Tell Dad.
hazards.help: You can say no and move the empty bucket without touching either cleaner.
hazards.reason: Everyone: fumes can harm people throughout the house.
hazards.remaining: Drag the bucket away from the bottles, then tap Tell Dad.

hazards.title: Towel
hazards.situation: Dad stepped out to answer the door. A dish towel hangs right next to a lit burner.
options: Call Dad back now. Step away.
Wait for Dad.
Turn up the burner so Dad can finish cooking sooner
outcomes: Dad moves the towel and stays with the cooking.
A towel by a flame can catch fire fast. Fire can spread to the cabinets.
A bigger flame, still next to the towel.
hazards.habit: Things that burn stay away from the stove, and someone stays with the cooking.
hazards.fix: Tap Tell Dad. Then tap Watch Dad move the towel. Stand back from the stove.
hazards.help: The lit burner and hot towel are for Dad to handle. Step back.
hazards.reason: Everyone: a stove fire can spread beyond the kitchen.
hazards.remaining: Stand back. Tap Watch Dad move the towel.

hazards.title: Candle
hazards.situation: A lit candle sits on the windowsill. The curtain is moving in the breeze, and no one is in the room.
options: Push the curtain back and tell Grandma after your game
Leave it for a grown-up to notice when they come back into the room
Ask Grandma to blow it out now
outcomes: The curtain can blow back into the flame.
A candle left alone near cloth can start a fire.
The flame is out, and no one has to watch it.
hazards.habit: Candles stay a foot away from anything that can burn, and go out when you leave the room.
hazards.fix: Tap Tell Grandma June, then hold the candle for 1 second to watch her blow it out.
hazards.help: Grandma handles the flame. You can stand back and watch.
hazards.reason: Everyone: a candle fire can spread beyond the living room.
hazards.remaining: hold the candle for 1 second to watch her blow it out.

hazards.title: Pills
hazards.target: Blocks beside Theo, away from the table
hazards.situation: Grandma June’s pill box is open on the low coffee table. Theo is building blocks right beside it.
options: Tell Grandma now. Keep Theo with his blocks.
Leave it. Tell Grandma later.
Hide it under a cushion.
outcomes: She puts it up high, out of sight.
This box is open. Even safety caps are not childproof.
Theo can still find it. Medicine belongs up high and out of sight.
hazards.habit: Medicine lives up high, out of sight.
hazards.fix: Tap Tell Grandma June, then drag the block bin toward Theo, away from the table.
hazards.help: Grandma handles the medicine. You can keep Theo busy away from the table.
hazards.reason: Mostly Theo this time: the open pill box is within his reach. Grandma puts it up and out of sight.
hazards.remaining: drag the block bin toward Theo, away from the table.

hazards.title: Smoke alarm
hazards.situation: The smoke alarm is on the floor with its battery out. The battery is in a toy car.
options: Keep the battery. Tell Dad later.
Ask Dad to replace the battery and test the alarm.
Climb up yourself, then ask a grown-up if it looks okay
outcomes: With no battery, the alarm cannot warn anyone about smoke.
The alarm is back on the ceiling and works.
You could fall, and no one checks that it works.
hazards.habit: A grown-up tests smoke alarms every month with the test button.
hazards.fix: Tap Tell Dad. Help Dad test it: hold the alarm’s Test button for 2 seconds.
hazards.help: Dad handles the battery and ceiling work. Help test only with Dad beside you.
hazards.reason: Everyone: a working smoke alarm warns the household.
hazards.remaining: Help Dad test it: hold the alarm’s Test button for 2 seconds.

hazards.title: Heater
hazards.target: At least 3 feet from the heater
hazards.situation: A space heater is running. A blanket is draped over a chair about one foot away.
options: Drape the blanket over the heater and show Dad how warm it gets
Turn the heater up, then tell a grown-up the hallway is warm
Pull the cool blanket 3 feet away.
outcomes: The blanket can catch fire.
More heat, still close to the blanket.
Nothing that burns is near the heater.
hazards.fix: Drag the cool blanket to 3 feet or more. Leave the heater untouched. Then tap Tell Dad.
hazards.help: The heater stays untouched; a cool blanket you can pull away is safe to move.
hazards.reason: Everyone: keeping things that burn away from heat protects the household.
hazards.remaining: Drag the blanket at least 3 feet away on the ruler, then tap Tell Dad. Arrow keys move it 6 inches.

hazards.title: Gummies
hazards.situation: A bottle of gummy vitamins is open on the counter. They look just like candy.
options: Try two; ask Dad.
Leave it for Dad.
Tell Dad. Keep Theo away.
outcomes: Vitamins are medicine. Only take them when a grown-up gives them.
Too many can make a child very sick, and Theo could find them.
The bottle is closed and put away.
hazards.habit: Vitamins are medicine too. Up high, out of sight.
hazards.fix: Tap Tell Dad. Stay away from the counter. Tap Watch Dad put the bottle away.
hazards.help: Dad handles the bottle. You can keep Theo away from the counter.
hazards.reason: Mostly Theo this time: the gummies look like candy and are within his reach. Dad puts them away.
hazards.remaining: Stay away from the counter. Tap Watch Dad put the bottle away.

hazards.title: Tub
hazards.situation: The tub is still full after Theo’s bath, and Theo is heading back toward it.
options: Fetch a towel.
Stay with Theo. Pull the plug. Call out for help.
Call Dad from the hall and leave Theo waiting by the water until you get back.
outcomes: A young child can slip under in a few seconds, without a sound.
The water drains, and Theo is never alone near it.
A young child can drown in only a few inches of water.
hazards.habit: Empty the tub right after a bath, and stay with little kids near water.
hazards.fix: Stay with Theo. Drag the plug chain up to drain the tub, then tap Tell Dad.
hazards.help: Stay beside Theo and call Dad while you drain the tub. Do not leave Theo to fetch help.
hazards.reason: Mostly Theo this time: he is near the bath water. Stay beside him and call Dad.
hazards.remaining: Stay with Theo. Drag the plug chain up to drain the tub, then tap Tell Dad.

hazards.title: Chat
hazards.situation: CoinKing_77 asks: “what school do you go to? I’ll send you free coins”. You don’t know this player.
options: Do not reply. Block and report.
Give your school name, then ask Dad if you can keep the coins
Ask for the coins first. Show a grown-up the messages after you get them.
outcomes: They can’t message you again, and a grown-up knows.
A stranger now knows where to find you every day.
You keep talking with someone you don’t know, who wants your details.
hazards.habit: Never share your school, address or phone online. Block, report, tell.
hazards.fix: Tap Block in the chat, then Report, then Tell Dad.
hazards.help: You can stop replying and block the player without sharing anything.
hazards.reason: Mostly you this time: your school and personal details stay private.
hazards.remaining: Tap Block in the chat, then Report, then Tell Dad.

hazards.title: Pop-up
hazards.situation: A pop-up says: “YOU WON 10,000 COINS! Type your password to claim.”
options: Type it; ask Dad.
Tap it. Show Dad.
Close it. Type nothing.
outcomes: Someone else can now get into your account.
Tapping can open a trick page that asks for more.
Your password stays yours.
hazards.habit: A message that asks for your password is a trick. Close it and tell.
hazards.fix: Tap the pop-up’s X close button, then tap Tell Dad.
hazards.help: You can close the pop-up without typing anything.
hazards.reason: Mostly you this time: your password and account stay private.
hazards.remaining: Tap the pop-up’s X close button, then tap Tell Dad.

hazards.title: Gate
hazards.situation: The pool gate is propped open with a flowerpot. Theo’s ball is by the pool.
options: Leave it for Dad.
Move the pot. Let the gate latch.
Run in for the ball, then tell a grown-up the gate was open
outcomes: Theo can walk straight to the water.
The gate is closed and latched.
Now you are at the pool with no grown-up watching.
hazards.habit: Pool gates close and latch by themselves. Never prop them open.
hazards.fix: Drag the flowerpot off the gate onto the patio, then tap Tell Dad.
hazards.help: From the patio side, move the pot without going through the pool gate.
hazards.reason: Mostly Theo this time: the latched gate blocks his unsupervised path to the pool. An adult still watches near water.
hazards.remaining: Drag the flowerpot off the gate onto the patio, then tap Tell Dad.

hazards.title: Lighter
hazards.situation: A lighter is on the patio table next to the grill.
options: Leave it alone. Tell Dad now.
Click it once and ask Dad if the flame is big enough for the grill
Carry it in your pocket until a grown-up has time to put it away
outcomes: The lighter goes up high, where kids can’t reach.
A flame near the table and grill can start a fire.
You are carrying a fire tool around.
hazards.habit: Matches and lighters are grown-up tools. Don’t touch, tell.
hazards.fix: Tap Tell Dad. Then tap the lighter to watch Dad put it on the high shelf.
hazards.help: Leave the lighter untouched. Dad puts it away.
hazards.reason: Everyone: keeping a fire tool out of children’s reach helps prevent fire.
hazards.remaining: Tap Watch Dad put the lighter away. Leave it untouched.
